core.notes:
A kept pop-up shows the move cursor only while you drag it
Hover pop-ups no longer close by themselves when the page redraws under a still mouse
A pop-up opened from another pop-up (or shown last) is always on top of it, and tooltips stay above both
Appearance › Tooltips: a new "Open after" setting for pop-ups, beside "Close after"; a kept pop-up now stays until you press its × or Escape
Profile Sync also reads your personal village tax rates
Profile Sync also reads the game's own multipliers inside your running sanctum
Partners tool: the What you gather now bars are much narrower, so the panel screenshots well
The menu's All Tweaks hover is sized to its text: a short line of names on top, then each Tweak's whole description
The daily check-in now also says on which of the last 14 days the game tab was open (days only, no times), so the maintainer can see how active a copy is without any extra request
Partners tool: the Pet modifiers table writes every set the same way ("1x Partner AS" first, then Speed, then Intelligence, with Speed and Intelligence tinted); a Partner invest box on the left (the gold in your partners' Intelligence and Speed, worked out from your levels); a Breakpoint panel that says when one more partner beats more levels on the partners you have; and a Compare panel that puts the same gold (100t to start) into pet slot levels and into partners
After AWOO+ updates, its daily diagnostics check-in goes at once instead of waiting up to 11 hours, and says whether your old second script (the extras one) is still running. Still only versions, nothing about your account
